# Game2048.vip

> Free online 2048 number puzzle at https://game2048.vip — slide tiles on a 4x4 grid; matching numbers merge until you reach 2048.

Play in the browser (keyboard arrows/WASD or swipe on mobile). Progress and best score save in local storage. Preferred host is the apex domain `https://game2048.vip` (not www).

- [Learning Center](https://game2048.vip/learn/): Guides from beginner to advanced
- [How to Play 2048](https://game2048.vip/learn/how-to-play-2048.html): Rules, controls, and basics
- [How to Win 2048](https://game2048.vip/learn/how-to-win-2048.html): Corner and snake strategies to beat 2048
- [2048 Strategy Guide](https://game2048.vip/learn/2048-strategy-guide.html): Advanced techniques for 4096+
